steph just dropped 34 in a 17 point comeback 🔥 // #stephcurry #nba #nbaedits #trending #today // Stephen Curry once again proved why he is one of the greatest basketball players of all time after delivering an outstanding performance against the Phoenix Suns, finishing with an incredible 34 points and seven assists. The Golden State Warriors superstar played a crucial role in leading his team to a hard-fought 116-113 victory, showcasing his incredible scoring ability, leadership and experience. Despite the Warriors facing a difficult challenge throughout the game, Curry refused to let his team fall behind, stepping up when they needed him most. One of the biggest moments of his performance came in the third quarter, where he exploded for 18 points and completely changed the momentum of the contest. His ability to create scoring opportunities from almost anywhere on the court made life extremely difficult for Phoenix's defence. Whether it was knocking down difficult three-pointers, creating separation from defenders or attacking the basket, Curry continued to demonstrate the offensive skills that have made him one of the most dangerous players in NBA history. Alongside his scoring, his seven assists highlighted his ability to involve his teammates and create opportunities for others. Curry's impact extended beyond the statistics, as his confidence and leadership helped Golden State remain competitive during some difficult stretches of the game.
